title: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms
description: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms is a Dungeons & Dragons strategy management game uniting characters from throughout the D&D multiverse into a grand adventure.

title: Flotsam
description: The floating garbage town survival game! Scavenge what precious garbage you can from the ocean's surface and grow your city while doing your best to survive in this colorful post-apocalyptic world.

title: Knightica
description:
Recruit units, place them strategically, and find the synergies in this Roguelike AutoBattler!
Knightica lets you guide a warband through challenges to free the Kingdoms.
Discover combinations, weave powerful enchants, face dangerous monsters, and lead your army to victory!
